context.// alertEmail: email address that receives CloudWatch alarm notifications
context.// replicaRegions: extra regions for the DynamoDB global table, e.g. ["us-west-2"]. Empty = single region.
context.// canaryEnabled: turn on the 5-minute bot-pages-bot canary once implemented
context.// apnsPlatformAppArn: SNS platform application ARN for APNs (iOS). Created out-of-band; empty = push disabled for iOS.
context.// fcmCredentialSecretName: Secrets Manager secret holding the Firebase service-account JSON (value set out of band, see README). The stack creates the FCM SNS platform app from it. Empty = push disabled for Android.
context.// fcmPlatformAppName: Name of the stack-managed FCM SNS platform application. Changing it replaces the app (new ARN; device endpoints re-register).
context.// fcmCredentialRotation: Bump after putting a new key in the secret; the next deploy pushes it to SNS in place (same ARN).
